findings.detail: seal_research publishes an immutable RESEARCH_READY.json with WRITING_AI_READY=true before the mandatory independent fact review. The same file says that review is pending, while the handoff reports research_locked=false and the durable research lock remains active. A rejected proposal can therefore remain available as an apparently ready canonical handoff.
findings.required_fix: Persist the proposal as locked and not writing-ready. After independent fact acceptance, publish a final research handoff and review record with consistent readiness and lock fields, and bind writing to that completion commit.

findings.detail: Research can begin after the last editorial.check but while a writing or localization model call is in flight. The English path can checkpoint the stale article and call its reviewer before checking the changed research head again. Publication is subsequently fenced, but stale work and paid review can occur during research remediation.
findings.required_fix: Fence model-stage starts against research mutation, and recheck the research fence immediately after each writing or localization call and before checkpointing or initiating review. Add interleaving tests for these active paths.

findings.detail: A delivery failure leaves the publication fence active. If the cached source evidence expires before recovery, the old epoch cannot pass evidence validation, while a new research epoch cannot begin because the fence blocks research mutations. No verified cancellation or reconciliation path is provided to release that fence.
findings.required_fix: Implement an operator-authorized, auditable recovery or abort protocol that verifies or invalidates partially created draft artifacts before releasing the fence. Test recovery after evidence expiry, including a new research epoch.

findings.detail: check_research rejects RESEARCH_FAIL or writing_ai_ready=false before a research packet is persisted. The engine records only a generic halt, so a failed article does not receive the required canonical verdict, blocked facts, source log and handoff.
findings.required_fix: Persist every research verdict, including FAIL and non-ready CONDITIONAL, under the research file boundary with its fact sheet, source log, blocked facts and handoff. Keep writing disabled until a fresh eligible version is completed.

findings.detail: The mandatory startup sequence requires a git pull before research and writing. The workflow checks out a pinned revision, and startup.verify compares local and remote-tracking identifiers, but the supplied active path does not perform the required pull. It nevertheless records PRE_RESEARCH_SYNC_PASS.
findings.required_fix: Implement the prescribed main synchronization sequence before research, verify the live origin head and record the actual resulting identifiers. Fail the startup gate if synchronization cannot be completed.

cloud-pilot-manual.yml.content:
name: AutoBridge multilingual API pilot
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: Offline inspection or separately approved real execution
        type: choice
        options: [preflight, account-check, audit, execute]
        default: preflight
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: autobridge-entire-real-pilot-program
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  trusted:
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    uses: xysjou/AutoBridge-Content-Pipeline/.github/workflows/cloud-pilot-trusted.yml@b3f5a6cef20b8dc235f001af306e635f1eca0fdf
    with:
      mode: ${{ inputs.mode }}
    secrets:
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
      AUTOBRIDGE_CONTROL_COMMIT: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_CONTROL_COMMIT }}
      AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256 }}

cloud-pilot-trusted.yml.content:
name: AutoBridge pinned protected runtime
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      mode:
        type: string
        required: true
    secrets:
      OPENAI_API_KEY:
        required: true
      AUTOBRIDGE_CONTROL_COMMIT:
        required: true
      AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256:
        required: true
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  inspect:
    if: inputs.mode == 'preflight'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - run: python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual preflight
  account-check:
    # Availability is inspected inside the code/lease-preauthorized execute path.
    # Disable the legacy standalone key-bearing path permanently.
    if: ${{ false }}
    environment: autobridge-pilot
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA }}
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Inspect only the two configured model metadata endpoints
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_ACCOUNT_CHECK_APPROVED: 'true'
        run: python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual account-check
  execute:
    if: >-
      (inputs.mode == 'execute' || inputs.mode == 'audit') &&
      vars.AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_ENABLED == 'true' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/integration/work-cloud-pilot-m1-20261102'
    environment: autobridge-pilot
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 180
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA }}
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Fetch reviewed control documents from a separate immutable commit
        env:
          AUTOBRIDGE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVAL_COMMIT: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_CONTROL_COMMIT }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA }}
        run: python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual.control
      - name: Validate exact run and workflow lease before exposing the project key
        env:
          AUTOBRIDGE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256 }}
        run: >-
          python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual preauthorize
          --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-plan.json"
          --prices "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-prices.json"
          --permit "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-permit.json"
      - name: Execute approved phase with the existing whole-program budget
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256 }}
          APPROVED_RUN_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
        run: >-
          python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual "$APPROVED_RUN_MODE"
          --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-plan.json"
          --prices "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-prices.json"
          --permit "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-permit.json"

articles.reason: The reserve covers a China-market 2024 Qiyuan Q05 PHEV, while the proposed task concerns an identified 2026 Q05 BEV and a shortlist decision that includes stock/availability, charging and service checks. The RHD guide mentions a Q05 Thai-market prospect, and the Southeast Asia SUV article supplies a country-specific shortlist method; neither answers the proposed vehicle-specific buying task. Keep the 2024 PHEV and 2026 BEV distinct, and do not assume the China and overseas names identify the same model without explicit OEM proof. Verification of the proposed 2026 vehicle identity and availability remains a research matter, not a deduplication finding.

The nearest pages cover refrigerated-truck configurations, chassis/body/refrigeration-unit separation, procurement checks, or general fleet acceptance criteria. The proposed buyer task is narrower and different: agree and document acceptance evidence for the completed reefer, including identity, cargo and ambient conditions, sensor records, door-opening pattern, power modes and responsibility. Keep it focused on the acceptance demonstration and evidence record; avoid repeating chassis/unit selection and model-specification material.
